axesRecognised.question: Who consumes the built output?
axesRecognised.values: npm package, deployed app, demo, internal instrument, research
axesRecognised.collapsesInto: Demoted to a carrier flag, not an axis — it never governs boundaries, dependency direction, or edit rights; carried by top-level directory habit (apps/, demos/) plus package.json private/publishConfig

basis.axis: Bounded context — the domain language a workspace speaks: curriculum (the Oak platform's ubiquitous language of lessons/units/threads), search (index docs, facets, ground truths, MRR), design/brand, graph, MCP delivery, agent-practice (sessions, seats, validators — the estate's own operational domain), generic infrastructure (vendor adapters and language-free mechanics), research
basis.role: Workspace boundaries and team navigation, and the primary directory-placement principle: a workspace never mixes two domain languages; cross-context consumption happens only through a published SDK/package surface (context-map translation), never by co-residence
basis.carrier: Directory level 2 under packages/ (packages/search/, packages/design/, packages/mcp/, packages/graph/, ...) plus the domain noun in the workspace name; enforced by oak-eslint boundary inventories. Recommendation diverging from the implied tree: packages/codegen/ is a clock-grouping, not a context — openapi-schema-source and openapi-pipeline belong to generic OpenAPI infrastructure, oak-vocab-mining to the curriculum context (the census's open question 1 invites exactly this tier-name ruling)
basis.rationale: DDD's first cut: a model is only coherent inside its context. Every governing conversation in the census is conducted in one domain language at a time; the reorganisation's splits (search-cli into bulk/ingest/eval/ground-truths, sdk-codegen into spec/pipeline/artifacts) are all recoveries of context seams that co-residence had smeared

basis.axis: Subdomain posture — DDD's strategic classification: generic subdomain (any organisation could adopt; commodity-supplier-facing) ↔ oak-configured (generic machinery parameterised by Oak config) ↔ oak core-domain leaf ↔ oak-proprietary (brand-reserved, non-travelling)
basis.role: Dependency direction (the enforceable predicate: generic never imports oak-prefixed; oak composes generic), licensing/extraction/travel (posture determines the travel destiny — es-ingest-core can leave for npm, oak-search-ingest cannot), and the extraction roadmap
basis.carrier: Name prefix (oak- vs unprefixed: es-ingest-core, mcp-server-express-core, search-eval-harness vs oak-search-ingest) + package.json license and publishConfig fields + a boundary lint rule enforcing the import-direction predicate
basis.rationale: The generic/core fault line is where the estate's value stack lives (foundational-building-blocks frame: context specificity is 'a second axis across all layers rather than a synonym for a layer'). It is orthogonal to context — search contains both es-ingest-core (generic) and oak-search-ingest (core) — and it alone answers what may travel and which way dependencies flow

basis.axis: Byte provenance / conformance relationship — who authors the language in the files and under which named upstream contract: hand-written in our language ↔ generated projection of a named published interface (DO-NOT-EDIT, regenerated wholesale when THAT contract's event fires: OpenAPI-spec tap, bulk tap, index-design contract, studio export) ↔ byte-preserved foreign capture ↔ editorial content (human-authored in the domain's published language, OGL)
basis.role: Edit rights and regeneration (the DO-NOT-EDIT boundary, one-declared-generator-per-surface, drift gates), and the change-clock as a derived property: the clock IS the named contract's freshness event, so 'two clocks never share a workspace' becomes 'two conformance contracts never share a workspace' — same verdict, proper-noun-grounded
basis.carrier: The packages/generated/* tier for cross-workspace artefact holders (a deliberate carve-out where the tree materialises this axis instead of context, context surviving in the name prefix: oak-api-*, oak-search-*); in-workspace generated/ directory convention; DO-NOT-EDIT markers; drift-gate validators; the regeneration event named in package.json scripts
basis.rationale: ACLs are DDD's answer to foreign models: the generated tiers are frozen translations of upstream published languages, the studio capture is a conformist verbatim import fenced behind its own boundary, editorial corpora are domain-expert knowledge captured as data. The generatedSeparationPolicy's ten clauses are all projections of this one axis — it is the estate's most-litigated defect class and cannot be derived from the other two

proposal.cardinalityArgument: Three, and the pressure is real in both directions. Drop to two by merging posture into context and you lose the only enforceable dependency-direction predicate and the entire extraction/travel story: es-ingest-core and oak-search-ingest sit in the same capability with opposite travel destinies, and no context label separates them. Drop provenance instead and you cannot state edit rights: DO-NOT-EDIT artefacts land beside editable code again, which is precisely the defect class (24MB data.json inside a code workspace, cross-workspace writes into src/) the ratified programme exists to cure — the generatedSeparationPolicy would have no axis to hang on. Go to four by promoting clock to an independent axis and you double-count: the clock is a consequence of which conformance contract a workspace holds, and clock-as-label already misclassifies in the census itself (oak-vocab-mining carries lifecycle codegen-time while its scope text says it runs on the bulk-refresh cadence). Promote reliance depth and you materialise a graph-derived quantity as declared structure, forcing tier churn every time a package gains a consumer — depth should be recomputed by a validator (validators-must-recompute-not-just-record), not asserted by placement. Every one of the eight observed axes either collapses into one of the three, derives from the dependency graph, or demotes to a metadata flag; each of the three answers at least one governing decision class the other two cannot reach.

hardCaseClassifications.case: openapi-schema-source + oak-bulk-data (one upstream, two acquisition workspaces)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Same proper-noun upstream, two distinct published interfaces — the OpenAPI-spec tap and the /api/bulk tap are separate conformance contracts, so DDD predicts one ACL each; provenance names the contract, the differing clocks follow for free. Context: generic-OpenAPI infra (schema-source, parameterised) and curriculum (bulk-data); posture: oak-configured vs oak-leaf
hardCaseClassifications.note: This case is the strongest argument FOR the DDD basis: 'one service, three taps on three clocks' is exactly 'one supplier, multiple published languages, one ACL per contract'

hardCaseClassifications.case: packages/generated/* tier (four artefact workspaces, different capability families)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Provenance-first placement by deliberate carrier assignment: the tree materialises provenance for this class (edit-right enforcement — Sonar exclusions, DO-NOT-EDIT gates, wholesale regeneration — binds per-directory), while context survives in the name prefix (oak-api-*, oak-search-*, oak-bulk-*, oak-curriculum-corpus-*)
hardCaseClassifications.note: A pure context-first tree would scatter these into their contexts; the carve-out is a real tension between two basis axes competing for the same tree level, resolved by carrier design rather than denied

hardCaseClassifications.case: oak-design-studio-capture (467 byte-preserved studio files)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Design context, oak posture, provenance = byte-preserved foreign capture: a conformist relationship with the Claude Design studio (their bytes taken verbatim, zero translation) fenced behind its own workspace and quality-gate boundary
hardCaseClassifications.note: The census's 'converts vigilance fences to structure' is the DDD move exactly: an ACL boundary replacing README/Sonar-exclusion vigilance

hardCaseClassifications.case: agent-tools residue (mixed-justified, Oak platform adapters)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Agent-practice context composition leaf, oak-leaf posture; internally it holds several vendor ACLs (Claude/Codex/Cursor platform adapters) plus one bounded generated region beside its generator — each individually too small to mint
hardCaseClassifications.note: The basis classifies it cleanly but would split it at scale; its internal multiplicity is tolerated by the minting-threshold judgment, which is proportionality doctrine (consolidate-at-second-consumer), not an axis — see residue

hardCaseClassifications.case: oak-search-ground-truths (OGL editorial content in a code estate)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Search context, oak posture (OGL travel terms carried in the license field), provenance = editorial content: domain-expert-authored knowledge in the domain's published language — DDD's ubiquitous language captured as data, never governed by the generated rule
hardCaseClassifications.note: The census's challenger correction (from generated-separation to handwritten) is the provenance axis doing its job

hardCaseClassifications.case: oak-design-assets (brand-reserved rasters)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Design context, posture = oak-proprietary (the non-travelling extreme of the posture axis), hand-authored provenance; the licensing seam IS the posture seam

hardCaseClassifications.case: research-evidence (research workspace)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Research context under DDD's separate-ways context-map pattern: deliberate no-dependency autonomy; oak-internal posture, hand-written probes with all output stdout or gitignored
hardCaseClassifications.note: Honest stretch: 'research' is a governance zone more than a domain language; the context axis absorbs it but the fit is by pattern (separate-ways) rather than by vocabulary

hardCaseClassifications.case: runtime-only-scripts (three files, maybe-workspace)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Agent-practice/operations context, oak-leaf posture, hand-written — classification is unambiguous; whether it becomes a workspace member at all is a minting-threshold question the basis does not decide
hardCaseClassifications.note: The open question is proportionality, not taxonomy; either answer (workspace or honest three-file shape) is basis-consistent

hardCaseClassifications.case: apps/ vs demos/ (audience: axis or habit?)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Both are composition roots of their contexts; the demo/product distinction is deployment intent, carried as a flag (top-level directory habit + package.json private/deploy config), not a basis axis — it never governs boundaries, dependency direction, or edit rights
hardCaseClassifications.note: Verdict: a real distinction, demoted to a carrier flag; promotion would be warranted only if demos acquire distinct governance (see futureTests)

hardCaseClassifications.case: es-ingest-core (generic machinery over a commodity service)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Generic subdomain posture (supplier-facing adapter speaking Elasticsearch's language, not Oak's — any provider could replace it), unprefixed name, MIT, travel-ready; sits in generic infrastructure beside posthog-node/sentry-node rather than inside the Oak search domain
hardCaseClassifications.note: The posture axis is what separates it from oak-search-ingest despite shared capability — the case the two-axis (context-only) basis cannot handle

hardCaseClassifications.case: oak-mcp-widget (own toolchain, build artefact embedded in a server)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: MCP-delivery context, oak posture, hand-written provenance; its build output becomes the published interface the server consumes as an ordinary declared dependency — the committed generated constant leaving the server's src/ is the provenance axis's no-cross-workspace-writes clause

hardCaseClassifications.case: corpus-instruments / repo-validators / agent-session-ops (product or practice?)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: Neither forced into the product: agent-practice is a bounded context in its own right — a distinct core domain of the meta-work with its own ubiquitous language (seats, claims, validators, fitness). Posture varies per member: agent-session-ops re-namespaced off OAK_* is portable/generic-posture practice core; repo-validators and corpus-instruments are estate-specific leaves
hardCaseClassifications.note: The question dissolves under the basis: 'product or practice' is a context question, and practice is a context, not a wart on the product

residue: Minting thresholds: the basis classifies every workspace but never decides whether a classified unit is big enough to BE a workspace (runtime-only-scripts, agent-tools' internal vendor-adapter multiplicity, every 'too-small-to-split rider'). That judgment belongs to proportionality doctrine (consolidate-at-second-consumer, hollow-wrapper rejections) and no axis set supplies it.

Transitional tree inconsistency: today's packages/core|libs|sdks tiers materialise reliance depth, which this basis treats as graph-derived; the recommended context-first level-2 coexists with the legacy depth tiers until the owner rules on tier names (census open question 1). The basis tolerates the hybrid but does not erase it — navigation pays the tax meanwhile.

Exact licence strings remain owner facts: posture predicts the travel class but cannot derive edge rulings — the licence of evaluation/baselines.json, the OGL/MIT dual marking for oak-search-ground-truths, and the marking of generated workspaces holding OGL-derived data are legal determinations the axis carries in package.json but cannot answer.

Editorial and brand workspaces have no upstream conformance contract, so their change-cause is a human decision with no derivable clock; the provenance axis names them (editorial / hand-authored) but says nothing about cadence — freshness expectations for ground truths and synonym vocabularies need separate operational ownership.

Audience stays demoted: if a demo ever acquires genuinely different governance (security posture, data-handling class, a paying external audience), the flag would need promotion to something enforceable, and the basis as stated has no fourth slot for it.

futureTests.note: The basis's home case: mint a new bounded context with one ACL per published interface of the new supplier (its own schema-source config, artifact holders, ingest); the generic machinery (openapi-pipeline, es-ingest-core, search-eval-harness) is reused as-is because posture kept it free of Oak knowledge. No re-rooting — a new sibling context directory and new conformance workspaces only.
A new composition root in its context: apps/ flag, thin leaf, consumes context SDKs across published surfaces. All three axes assign values without strain.

futureTests.futureClass: Extraction of a generic package to npm/another repo
futureTests.note: Extraction is lifting a unit the posture axis already prepared: unprefixed name, MIT license field, lint-enforced zero oak-imports mean the workspace is travel-ready by construction — the axis's whole purpose.
Generic-infrastructure context, supplier-named workspace beside posthog-node/sentry-node/es-ingest-core; posture generic, provenance hand-written. Routine.

futureTests.futureClass: A second demo consumer team adopting the estate
futureTests.note: Navigation is served by context tiers plus posture naming; demos are flagged entry points. Caveat recorded in residue: if that team's demos acquire distinct governance, the audience flag would need promotion — the one future that could press a fourth axis into existence.

axesRecognised.question: How many things stand on this: core primitive, foundational system, domain SDK, or composition leaf?
axesRecognised.values: core primitives | foundational systems | domain/SDKs | composition leaves
axesRecognised.collapsesInto: derived from the dependency graph (plus strong correlation with knowledge-provenance per the value-stack frame's own note that context specificity is 'a second axis across all layers'); declaring it as a stored classification would mint a drift surface between declaration and graph, contra validators-must-recompute — enforcement lives in the boundary rules that recompute direction from actual imports

basis.role: workspace boundaries (the two-clocks test is the mandatory-split rule) and tranche sequencing; the primary Parnas axis — each workspace encapsulates exactly one freshness event
basis.carrier: package.json field (a declared per-workspace clock, today the census's lifecycle value) enforced by a repo-validator that recomputes it from the declared generator edges and turbo task graph rather than trusting the declaration; NOT carried by the directory tree
basis.rationale: This axis forced more ratified splits than any other: 30+ inventory entries carry dimension=lifecycle, and the generatedSeparationPolicy states it as law ('artefacts on different regeneration clocks never share a workspace... the two-clocks test is what distinguishes a mandatory workspace split from directory hygiene'). It also subsumes upstream identity: the Oak platform is one service but three taps on three clocks, and the inventory splits along the clocks (openapi-schema-source vs oak-bulk-data), not the service.

basis.role: dependency direction (generic never imports branded; oak-configured composes generic; oak-leaf composes both) and, jointly with byte-authorship, licensing and extraction/travel — a generic workspace is pre-cleared for npm/another-repo extraction
basis.carrier: name prefix convention (oak-* vs unprefixed: es-ingest-core, mcp-server-express-core, search-eval-harness vs oak-search-ingest, oak-bulk-ingest) plus the oak-eslint boundary fences that enforce the import direction; independently proven by workspace pairs on one clock split by this axis alone
basis.rationale: es-ingest-core vs oak-search-ingest and openapi-pipeline vs oak-sdk-codegen are pairs identical on clock and authorship, split purely here — so it cannot collapse into clock. It is the axis the value-stack frame ratifies ('context specificity is a second axis across all layers rather than a synonym for a layer'), it answers the extraction future-class by construction, and with byte-authorship it derives the licence field, discharging a would-be fifth axis.

basis.role: edit rights and regeneration discipline — who may change a byte and by what act; jointly with provenance, licensing (editorial content -> OGL, brand assets -> reserved, code -> MIT)
basis.carrier: directory level 2 for the generated value only (the packages/generated/* tier materialises it), with the other three values carried by the generatedSeparationPolicy machinery: declared generator edges with drift gates and DO-NOT-EDIT headers for generated files inside dedicated generated/ dirs, a dedicated own-quality-gate workspace for byte-preserved capture (converting the Sonar-exclusion vigilance fence to structure), and editorial-content declaration for the OGL/brand corpora
basis.rationale: Independent of clock: openapi-schema-source and oak-api-artifacts share the upstream-spec clock yet must be separate workspaces because one is hand-written and one is regenerated wholesale. Independent of provenance: generated artefacts exist at every provenance level. Ten ratified policy clauses (generatedSeparationPolicy) hang off this axis alone, and it is the only axis with a four-valued answer the census was forced to correct mid-flight (oak-search-ground-truths re-dimensioned because handwritten editorial content is NOT generated) — evidence the distinction is load-bearing, not decorative.

basis.role: directory placement (level 1: packages/ apps/ demos/ research/ plus an instruments tier for the agent-practice estate) team navigation, and publish/deploy governance — which quality-gate and promotion regime applies
basis.carrier: directory level 1, exclusively — a closed five-value enumeration the top-level tree already materialises; no per-file or per-import enforcement needed
basis.rationale: Cannot be derived: oak-curriculum-hub and oak-curriculum-mcp-streamable-http agree on clock, provenance, and authorship yet one is a demonstration instrument and one is a product, governed differently (owner doctrine: demos are demonstration instruments, never implicitly system parts). It also answers the census's own first open question — where the homeless mints (corpus-instruments, repo-validators, agent-session-ops, es-ingest-core, mcp-server-express-core) land — by principle rather than habit: internal instruments get an instruments tier, reusable libraries go under packages/, regardless of capability family.

proposal.cardinalityArgument: Four — but as three-plus-one, which is the owner's 'maybe not' case. Three intensive axes (clock, provenance, authorship) are each proven independent by a ratified workspace pair separated by that axis alone: openapi-schema-source vs oak-bulk-data (clock only — same upstream service, same key), openapi-schema-source vs oak-api-artifacts (authorship only — same spec clock), es-ingest-core vs oak-search-ingest (provenance only — same ingest clock). Drop any one and a ratified boundary in the 66 becomes underivable; drop clock and the entire two-clocks split law loses its axis; drop authorship and the ten-clause generatedSeparationPolicy has no referent; drop provenance and dependency direction plus the extraction future-class dangle. These three jointly derive licence, so a licence axis would be redundant. The fourth axis (audience) is different in kind: extensive, closed, five-valued, carried entirely by the top-level directory names that already exist — its marginal carrier cost is zero — and it is not derivable (hub vs MCP server agree on all three intensive axes yet are governed as demo vs product; research/ is a third regime). A three-axis basis is possible only by declaring audience 'naming habit', which hard case 9's evidence contradicts and which would leave apps/demos/research placement, publish governance, and the census's own open question 1 unanswered — hidden residue larger than the axis. A fifth axis dilutes provably: capability family never decides a boundary, dependency, or edit right (the generated tier spans four families); reliance depth is recomputable from the dependency graph and storing it mints a drift surface; upstream identity is a clock source, not an axis; licence is derived. So: one fewer loses ratified boundaries or hides real governance; one more adds a classification that decides nothing the graph or the other axes do not already decide.

hardCaseClassifications.placement: Fully classifiable — clock=runtime, provenance=oak-leaf, authorship=code, audience=internal instrument — whether or not it becomes a member; the open question is a minimum-size/worthiness threshold, which is proportionality doctrine, not taxonomy.
hardCaseClassifications.note: The basis is deliberately silent on granularity; named in residue.

hardCaseClassifications.placement: Real axis, and the fourth basis member: hub and the MCP server agree on all three intensive axes yet carry different governance (product vs demonstration instrument; owner doctrine that demos are never implicitly system parts; the showcase purge as an audience-driven event).

hardCaseClassifications.case: es-ingest-core (generic machinery over a commodity service)
hardCaseClassifications.placement: provenance=generic — depending on a swappable commodity (Elasticsearch) does not make code oak-specific; clock=ingest-time; unprefixed name carries the provenance; pre-cleared for extraction, MIT derived.

basis.carrier: Enforced rule over the dependency graph: oak-eslint boundary inventories + validate-boundaries parity gate hold the declared locus per workspace; the oak-* name prefix is the human-readable echo of the declaration; the enforcement is a computable check (no edge from a generic workspace reaches an oak-declared workspace), so the declaration is recomputed, not trusted
basis.rationale: This is the one axis the graph cannot DERIVE but can fully ENFORCE: it is a direction constraint on edges, the same mechanical kind as import-order rules. It answers the extraction future-class directly (es-ingest-core, openapi-pipeline, mcp-server-express-core, agent-session-ops all carry 'reusable' warrants whose only testable meaning is closure Oak-freeness) and it is the axis under which oak-vs-reusable mints in the census were justified

proposal.cardinalityArgument: Three, because that is the count of independent facts the build system can enforce. Drop to two and a governing decision goes unanswerable: without change clock, the census's plurality mint warrant (two clocks never share a workspace) has no axis and workspace boundaries revert to taste; without byte provenance & travel, edit rights, drift gates, and licence propagation have no home and DO-NOT-EDIT stays a vigilance convention; without knowledge locus, dependency direction and the extraction test lose their only testable definition — 'reusable' becomes prose. Independence is demonstrated pairwise by the estate itself: generic codegen-time (openapi-pipeline), oak-leaf generated (oak-api-artifacts), oak-leaf hand-written editorial (oak-search-ground-truths), generic hand-written ingest-time (es-ingest-core) — no axis predicts another. Add a fourth and it dilutes: a separate licence axis has its value determined for ~64 of 66 workspaces by provenance roots plus graph propagation (the two seam cases are root-homogeneity inside axis 2); a capability-family axis is derivable as graph communities, enforces nothing, and would tempt boundary rules the locus rule already covers where they matter; a reliance-depth axis is pure topological position, computed for free; an upstream-context axis names a host the graph never sees. The build-graph principle is the razor: an axis earns a basis seat only if some governing decision fails without a declared-and-recomputed carrier for it, and exactly three survive that test.

residue: Team navigation / capability-family grouping: the basis cannot derive or enforce it. Graph communities SUGGEST the families (the search cluster, the design cluster), and level-2 directory names materialise them for humans, but nothing recomputes the assignment and no rule should bind it. Navigation is answered by convention riding the directory carrier, not by the basis — the one listed governing decision the basis serves only decoratively.

Cross-tap unity of a single upstream service: the Oak platform's three taps become three unrelated graph entries; a platform-wide breaking migration (new host, new auth) has no single taxonomy handle and must be coordinated through the shared env schema and runbooks.

The product-vs-practice felt distinction in the agent estate: locus plus graph position approximate it, but the residual sense in which repo-validators is 'the Practice, not the product' is carried nowhere the tooling can see.

Standing mixed-clock waivers: agent-tools, build-metadata, and research-evidence each hold multiple clocks under explicit justification; the two-clocks rule therefore needs a named-waiver register in the validator, and every waiver is a permanent small hole in axis 1's enforcement.

Deployment/audience truth (published npm vs deployed app vs demo vs research): carried by per-workspace facts (publishConfig, deploy config, directory naming), never by the basis; a reader wanting 'everything we actually ship to strangers' must query those fields, not the taxonomy.

Off-graph files: anything outside pnpm-workspace membership (the pre-adoption runtime-only-scripts shape, root-level dotfiles and hooks) is invisible to all three axes; the basis governs only graph members, by construction of its first principle.

basis.role: Directory placement and team navigation: the primary question-to-file route ('where is the search synonym machinery?' → packages/search/) and the Conway floor a future team inherits whole (a search team, an mcp/agent-experience team, a design team, a curriculum-data team, an agent-practice team, a platform team)
basis.carrier: Directory level 2 under packages/ (packages/<family>/<workspace>); the family segment of leaf-app and demo names; degenerate for research records
basis.rationale: Conway's law run forward: directories exist so future owners have a contiguous floor and so navigators land by capability, which is how humans and agents actually phrase questions. The census's own new tiers (packages/search/, packages/mcp/, packages/graph/, packages/design/) show the estate already drifting from depth-tiers to family-tiers; this basis completes the drift. Every workspace in the 66-row inventory takes exactly one family without argument.

basis.role: Dependency direction, licensing/extraction, and top-level placement: a single ordered scale — generic → oak-published → oak-estate → terminal leaves {product-app, demo, research-record, practice-instrument} — with one rule: a workspace may import only equal-or-wider reach. This subsumes generic-never-imports-oak, apps-consume-packages, and answers 'can this leave for npm/another repo' by reading the coordinate
basis.carrier: Directory level 1 for the terminal band (apps/, demos/, research/, tools/); the oak- name prefix within packages/ (absence = generic = extraction-ready); package.json private/publishConfig/license; the oak-eslint boundary fence enforcing import monotonicity (recomputed from the dependency graph per validators-must-recompute)
basis.rationale: Merging observed axes 1, 8, and the direction half of 4 into one ordered scale is the load-bearing compression: specificity and deployment class never answer different governing questions — both are 'who may rely on this'. The merge survives its hardest counter-example: oak-curriculum-sdk is npm-published yet Oak-knowledged, and ranking oak-published BELOW generic correctly forbids generic code importing it while still letting it travel; it also surfaces the real constraint that a published package's workspace deps must themselves publish or bundle.

basis.role: Edit rights and regeneration ('may an agent edit this file, and what regenerates it?'), plus — jointly with family and reach — licence derivation (code→MIT; content×curriculum→OGL; content×brand→reserved)
basis.carrier: package.json marker as the machine authority (generated / editorial-content / captured), the -artifacts and -capture name suffixes as the human signal, DO-NOT-EDIT file headers, and the ratified drift-gate validators (one declared generator per tracked generated surface). The ratified generated-separation POLICY (generated never co-resident with hand-written; two clocks never share a workspace) is kept in full; only the implied packages/generated/* PATH is dropped, because the tree's two levels are spent on reach and family — artefact workspaces home under their family with provenance carried by marker+suffix+validator
basis.rationale: Agents are first-class navigators here and their most dangerous failure is hand-editing an artefact; but 'can I edit this?' is answered at the file and by validator, while 'where do the search mappings come from?' is answered by the tree — so the tree goes to family and provenance rides non-directory carriers. Conway agrees: generated artefacts are owned by their generator's family team, not by a 'generated team' that will never exist. The single learnable fence ('never edit under packages/generated/') is preserved as 'never edit a *-artifacts workspace', enforced mechanically.

basis.role: Workspace boundaries: the two-clocks test is the minting criterion (artefacts or code on different freshness events never share a workspace), and the clock coordinate names each workspace's regeneration cadence and what event obligates attention to it
basis.carrier: Declared lifecycle field in package.json, recomputed and enforced from the turbo task graph by a repo-validator (declaration alone would rot); never a directory level — the census's implied packages/codegen/ tier names a clock, not a family, and is a carrier error under this basis
basis.rationale: Clock is provably independent of the other three: openapi-schema-source and oak-bulk-data agree on family (curriculum-data), reach (oak-estate), and provenance, and are two workspaces solely because upstream-spec-deploy and bulk-refresh are different events. Remove this axis and the exact defect class this whole programme cures (mixed-clock workspaces like the old oak-sdk-codegen) becomes unstatable. It also cleanly absorbs the upstream-bounded-context observation: one proper-noun service, three taps, three clocks, several workspaces — as the census already concluded.

proposal.cardinalityArgument: Four, with the tree carrying exactly two of them. One fewer breaks a governing decision outright: drop change-clock and openapi-schema-source/oak-bulk-data re-merge (same family, reach, provenance), recreating the mixed-clock workspace defect the 34→66 programme exists to cure; drop byte-provenance and edit-rights, drift gates, and the OGL/MIT/reserved seams have no generator — agents hand-edit artefacts again; drop reach and dependency direction, extraction rights, and the apps/demos/packages/research top level all lose their common generator (three separate ad-hoc rules reappear); drop family and navigation degenerates to grep while no future team has a contiguous floor to own — the Conway premise itself. One more dilutes because the candidate fifth axes are each derivable or empty: re-splitting reach into specificity+audience buys only the 'generic deployed app' cell, which this estate cannot populate (every app composes Oak configuration by definition), and its hardest case (published-but-Oak oak-curriculum-sdk) is already expressed as the oak-published rank; re-splitting clock into clock+upstream-context adds only the vendor's name, read off package.json dependencies; reinstating reliance depth adds only what the dependency graph already proves and the reach-monotonicity fence already enforces (which is why core/ vs libs/ as tiers carry no information and fold into a platform family); licence is a recorded derivation, not a coordinate. The FACT constraint lands exactly: a tree materialises at most two axes — here level 1 is the reach terminal band (apps/, demos/, research/, tools/, packages/) and level 2 is family — and the remaining two axes ride package.json fields, name affixes, and recomputing validators, all carriers the estate already trusts.

challenge.recommendedSynthesis: Adopt P1's structure with P3's carrier machinery and P4's two named catches; harvest P2 for diagnostics, not for its basis. Concretely: THREE intensive basis axes — change-clock, Oak-specificity/travel-posture, byte-authorship (four values: hand-written code, editorial content, generated, byte-preserved capture) — which is exactly the census's own dimension vocabulary, each proven independent by a clean ratified pair (generated/* internal splits for clock; es-ingest-core vs oak-search-ingest for specificity; openapi-schema-source vs oak-api-artifacts for authorship). PLUS audience/deployment as a closed, non-derivable, declared classification carried entirely by tree level 1 (apps/ demos/ research/ tools-or-instruments/ packages/): P1's three-plus-one is the honest cardinality answer to the owner's 'four is almost certainly too much, but maybe not' — three axes decide boundaries, dependencies, edits, and travel; the plus-one decides level-1 placement and publish/deploy governance, costs no new carrier, and cannot be derived (hub vs MCP server). Reject P4's reach merge (agent-session-ops holds two reach values at once — specificity and audience must stay separate) and reject P2's clock collapse (it loses oak-search-index-lifecycle vs oak-search-sdk and every no-foreign-contract lifecycle mint). Carriers: clock as a declared per-workspace freshness-EVENT field with values finer than the census lifecycle enum (upstream-spec-deploy, index-design, bulk-truing, mining, editorial, brand, hook, own-build, runtime — the current enum provably cannot state the two-clocks law), recomputed from turbo/generator edges where a mechanical signature exists and carried as a named waiver where it does not (editorial/brand, mixed-justified); specificity as oak-prefix + boundary fences + recomputing closure test (P3's mechanism); authorship as the packages/generated/* tier kept per ratified policy clause 1, plus markers, drift gates, and the capture workspace's own quality gate; licence as a declared root class propagated along generator edges (P3's propagation — the best mechanical narrowing of open question 3), package.json authoritative with a recomputing consistency check. Capability family survives as curated level-2 naming with zero rule authority; rename or dissolve packages/codegen/ (two independent flaggers: it names a clock, not a family) and pre-register P4's oak- prefix disambiguation before a second upstream arrives. Depth: computed, never declared. Upstream identity: no axis; carry cross-tap unity in the env schema and a platform-migration runbook (P3's residue, priced up). Named residue to carry forward honestly: minting thresholds (proportionality doctrine), mixed-justified waiver register, OGL-derived-generated licence edges (owner facts), and family-label adjudication for dual-family workspaces (oak-bulk-data; es-ingest-core's shelf) — an owner naming decision the basis deliberately does not make.
